list.title: Sales
list.description: What the cooperative has sold, to whom, and what is still owed on it.
list.caption: Every sale, with its reference, date, buyer, store, total and what is still owed.
list.loadFailed: We could not load the sales. Check your connection and try again.
list.totalsCover: Confirmed sales only, across every page of this filter. A draft is not counted.
list.emptyTitle: No sale has been recorded yet
list.emptyBody: Write up the first sale and it appears here as a draft until somebody confirms it.
list.emptyFilteredBody: Choose another buyer, store or period, or clear the filters to see every sale.

statusMeaning.DRAFT: Nothing has left the store and no money has been recorded.
statusMeaning.CONFIRMED: The stock has left the store and the sale stands.
statusMeaning.CANCELLED: The sale was put out of service and what it did was reversed.

filters.buyerPlaceholder: Search by name, organisation or phone number
filters.buyerClear: Remove the buyer from this filter

summary.title: What was sold over this period
summary.description: Confirmed sales between {{from}} and {{to}}. A draft is an intention somebody typed, so none is counted here.
summary.loadFailed: We could not load the summary for this period.
summary.chartEmpty: Nothing was sold in this period, so there is no chart to draw.
summary.tableCaption: What was sold in each period of this range, as exact figures.
summary.topBuyersEmpty: No buyer has a confirmed sale in this period.
summary.topProductsEmpty: No product has been sold in this period.

form.newDescription: The sale is saved as a draft. Nothing leaves the store and no money is recorded until somebody confirms it.
form.editDescription: The lines are replaced by what is here, so leave in place anything that is still being sold.
form.loadFailed: We could not load that sale. Check your connection and try again.
form.notADraftTitle: This sale is no longer a draft
form.notADraftBody: A confirmed or cancelled sale cannot be changed. Cancel it and record a new one instead.
form.buyerPlaceholder: Search by name, organisation or phone number
form.buyerClear: Remove the buyer from this sale
form.saleDateHint: Today, unless the sale happened on another day.
form.linesDescription: One line for each product. A line priced at 0 is how something given away is recorded.
form.productPlaceholder: Search by name or product code
form.productClear: Remove the product from this line
form.productHintUncounted: Code {{sku}} · not counted in the store
form.quantityHintUnit: In {{unit}}. Three decimal places at most, for example 400.500.
form.quantityHint: Digits only. Three decimal places at most.
form.unitPriceHint: Two decimal places at most. 0 records something given away.
form.overStockWarning: The store is recorded as holding {{onHand}} and this line asks for {{asked}}. A draft for more than the store holds is allowed; the stock is checked when the sale is confirmed.
form.discountHint: Leave empty when nothing was taken off. It can never be more than the lines together.
form.taxHint: Leave empty when no tax applies to this sale.
form.computedNote: These figures are worked out here so they can be checked against what is being agreed. The sale is priced by the server, which is what the receipt and the books use.
form.noteHint: One line the office will still understand next year, for example: collected by lorry RAB 123 C.

formErrors.buyer: Choose the buyer this sale is for.
formErrors.warehouse: Choose the store the stock leaves from.
formErrors.noLines: Add at least one line. A sale of nothing is not a sale.
formErrors.product: Choose the product this line is for.
formErrors.quantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero, with at most three decimal places.
formErrors.unitPrice: Enter a price with at most two decimal places. 0 is allowed.
formErrors.discount: Enter a discount with at most two decimal places.
formErrors.discountTooLarge: The discount is more than the lines come to, which would make the sale a negative amount. Lower it to {{subtotal}} or less.
formErrors.tax: Enter a tax figure with at most two decimal places.
formErrors.saleDate: Enter the date as a real day.
formErrors.note: That note is too long for the office to keep. Shorten it.

detail.title: Sale {{reference}}
detail.loadFailed: We could not load that sale. Check your connection and try again.
detail.draftNotice: This sale is a draft. Nothing has left the store and no money has been recorded, so the lines can still be changed.
detail.cancelledNotice: This sale was cancelled. The stock went back into the store and the income was reversed, both as new entries rather than as deletions.
detail.linesCaption: Each line of this sale, with the product, the quantity, the price of one and what the line comes to.
detail.paymentsCaption: Every payment recorded against this sale, with its reference, date and method.
detail.paymentsEmptyBody: Record a payment when the buyer pays, and it is posted into the books at the same time.
detail.movementsCaption: Each stock movement this sale wrote, with its reference, product and quantity.
detail.movementsEmptyTitle: No stock has left the store
detail.movementsEmptyBody: The stock comes out when the sale is confirmed, and each line gets a movement of its own.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm this sale
confirmDialog.description: Confirming takes the stock out of the store, records a movement for every line and marks the sale. It cannot be undone; a confirmed sale is cancelled instead.
confirmDialog.restateOneLine: One line leaves {{warehouse}} and {{buyer}} is charged {{total}}.
confirmDialog.paymentIntro: Taking payment now is the usual case at a counter. Leave the amount empty when the buyer is paying later.
confirmDialog.amountPaidHint: Never more than the total. Leave empty when nothing has been handed over.
confirmDialog.incomeCategory: Where the money goes in the books
confirmDialog.noPaymentFields: Recording the money needs the books, which your role does not cover. Confirm the sale here and somebody with the books can record the payment afterwards.
confirmDialog.insufficientTitle: The store cannot fill this sale
confirmDialog.insufficientBody: The sale is still a draft and nothing has moved: no stock came out and no money was recorded. Read it again to see the quantities as they are now, or lower the lines.
confirmDialog.done: {{reference}} is confirmed and the stock has left {{warehouse}}.

confirmErrors.amountPaid: Enter an amount with at most two decimal places, or leave it empty.
confirmErrors.incomeCategory: Choose where this money goes in the books. A payment has to say that.

paymentDialog.title: Record a payment
paymentDialog.description: The payment is posted into the books in the same act, so the sale and the accounts cannot disagree about what was received.
paymentDialog.amountHint: Never more than what is still owed.
paymentDialog.incomeCategory: Where the money goes in the books
paymentDialog.paidOnHint: Today, unless the money came in on another day.
paymentDialog.noteHint: One line the office will still understand next year, for example: mobile money reference 44821.

paymentErrors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero, with at most two decimal places.
paymentErrors.tooMuch: That is more than the {{outstanding}} still owed. A buyer's change is not the cooperative's business to record.
paymentErrors.incomeCategory: Choose where this money goes in the books.
paymentErrors.paidOn: Enter the date as a real day.
paymentErrors.note: That note is too long for the office to keep. Shorten it.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel sale {{reference}}?
cancelDialog.consequenceConfirmed: The stock goes back into the store and the income is reversed, both as new entries rather than as deletions, so the history still says what happened. The sale stays on record as cancelled.
cancelDialog.consequenceDraft: The draft is put out of service. Nothing had left the store and no money had been recorded, so there is nothing to put back.
cancelDialog.reasonHint: Required. A cancelled sale nobody can explain is one nobody can audit.
cancelDialog.reasonError: Say why this sale is being cancelled.
cancelDialog.done: {{reference}} was cancelled and what it did has been reversed.

buyers.title: Buyers
buyers.description: Who the cooperative sells to, what each has bought and what each still owes.
buyers.caption: Every buyer, with where they are, what they have bought and what they still owe.
buyers.loadFailed: We could not load the buyers. Check your connection and try again.
buyers.includeInactive: Show buyers taken out of use
buyers.includeInactiveHint: A buyer is never deleted, because every sale names them. Taking one out of use only keeps them out of new sales.
buyers.totalsCover: Confirmed sales only. A draft is an intention somebody typed, not business the cooperative did.
buyers.emptyTitle: No buyer has been recorded yet
buyers.emptyBody: Add the first buyer and every sale to them is kept on one record.
buyers.emptyFilteredBody: Try part of a name, an organisation or a phone number, or clear the search.

buyerProfile.loadFailed: We could not load that buyer. Check your connection and try again.
buyerProfile.totalsCover: Confirmed sales only, over this buyer's whole history.
buyerProfile.historyCaption: Every sale to this buyer, newest first, with its state and what is still owed.
buyerProfile.historyEmptyTitle: No sale to this buyer yet
buyerProfile.historyEmptyBody: Record a sale and it appears here with what is still owed on it.
buyerProfile.historyWithheld: Reading the sales themselves needs a sales permission, which your role does not cover. The figures above come from the buyer's own record.
buyerProfile.outOfUse: This buyer has been taken out of use, so a new sale cannot name them. What they bought before is untouched.

buyerDialog.createDescription: A name is all that is required. Whoever is at the counter often has nothing else, and a sale that goes unrecorded is worse than a record with gaps.
buyerDialog.editDescription: A buyer is never deleted, because every sale names them. Taking them out of use keeps them out of new sales and leaves their history alone.
buyerDialog.name: Name
buyerDialog.nameHint: The person or the organisation the sale is made out to.
buyerDialog.notesHint: Anything the office should know next season, for example: collects by lorry on Fridays.
buyerDialog.isActiveHint: Turning this off keeps them out of new sales. Nothing already recorded changes.
buyerDialog.doneCreated: {{name}} was added and can now be named on a sale.

buyerErrors.name: Enter the name the sale is made out to.
buyerErrors.email: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
buyerErrors.phone: Enter a phone number, or leave it empty.
buyerErrors.text: That is longer than the office can keep. Shorten it.

receipt.title: Receipt for sale {{reference}}
receipt.loadFailed: We could not load the receipt. Check your connection and try again.
receipt.linesCaption: Each line of this sale, with the product, the quantity, the price of one and what the line comes to.
receipt.noPayments: Nothing has been paid against this sale.
receipt.draftWarning: This sale is still a draft. Nothing has left the store and no money has been recorded, so this is not a receipt for business done.
receipt.cancelledWarning: This sale was cancelled on {{when}}. The stock went back and the income was reversed.

apiErrors.buyerNameTaken: Another buyer of this cooperative is already recorded under that name. Open that buyer instead of adding a second one.
apiErrors.buyerInactive: That buyer has been taken out of use, so a new sale cannot name them. Bring them back into use first.
apiErrors.warehouseClosed: That store has been closed, so stock cannot leave it. Choose another store.
apiErrors.productRetired: One of these products has been retired and cannot be sold. Remove the line, or bring the product back into use.
apiErrors.notADraft: That sale is no longer a draft, so its lines cannot be changed. Cancel it and record a new one.
apiErrors.alreadyConfirmed: That sale has already been confirmed. The stock has left the store and the money stands as recorded.
apiErrors.alreadyCancelled: That sale has already been cancelled.
apiErrors.cancelled: That sale was cancelled, so it cannot be confirmed. Record a new one instead.
apiErrors.noLines: That sale has no lines, so there is nothing to confirm. Add what is being sold first.
apiErrors.paymentNeedsConfirmed: A payment can only be recorded against a confirmed sale. Confirm it first.
apiErrors.insufficientStock: The store cannot fill this sale. Nothing has moved and the sale is still a draft.

fieldErrors.discountTooLarge: The discount is more than the lines come to. Lower it.
fieldErrors.paymentExceedsTotal: That is more than the sale is worth. A buyer's change is not the cooperative's business to record.
fieldErrors.paymentExceedsOutstanding: That is more than what is still owed on this sale.
